brief: Digital cyberpunk/vaporwave graffiti: angular broken neon tag gestures, pixel-sorted fragments, dithering, CRT scanline patches, warped wireframe fragments, broken arcs and glitch slashes. Muted violet, icy blue, cyan and small hot-pink highlights on plum-black. Sparse central 65 percent; denser expressive marks at the edges. No physical spray-painted wall, bubble lettering, readable writing, city or UI panels.
treatment: Converted the generated original to 1920px-wide WebP at quality 82. Applied as a faint screen-blended wallpaper; reading pages use a quieter opacity.
